summary: Mobile-only frontend retest of the Signup Onboarding flow on the Expo web preview. All 8 requested scenarios PASS end-to-end: invalid code humanization, DEVOS100 redeem -> onboarding-step-persona with all 6 persona cards, persona-team + onboarding-project-name + onboarding-finish (POST /api/chats -> 200 and PATCH /api/user/onboarding -> 200, landed on /(tabs) showing the newly-created 'QA Team Project Alpha' chat), persona-personal + template chip + finish, persona-enterprise immediate finish, persona-other immediate finish, onboarding-skip, no onboarding on reload after completion, and demo-login-btn goes straight to Chats (no onboarding).
critical_code_review_comments: onboarding.tsx finish() still swallows API errors and routes to /(tabs) regardless (main agent noted this is intentional for parity with web). If PATCH /api/user/onboarding fails silently, the user would be looped back into onboarding on next load. In this retest the PATCH returned 200 and the reload check confirmed onboarding is not shown again, so no user-visible regression.
